rm(list=ls())
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(readr)

collapse_genes <- function(mat) {
    mat <- as.matrix(mat)
    storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"    
    rn <- rownames(mat)
    message("Collapsing duplicated gene rows by mean expression...")    
    out <- rowsum(mat, group = rn, reorder = FALSE)    
    counts <- as.numeric(table(factor(rn, levels = rownames(out))))    
    out <- sweep(out, 1, counts, FUN = "/")    
    return(out)
}

median_center <- function(expression_matrix) {
    mat <- as.matrix(expression_matrix)
    storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"    
    row_medians <- apply(mat, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    centered <- sweep(mat, 1, row_medians, FUN = "-")    
    rownames(centered) <- rownames(mat)
    colnames(centered) <- colnames(mat)    
    centered
}

classify_nearest_centroid <- function( my_data, centroids_ref, min_genes = 300, min_margin = 0.05) {
    my_data <- collapse_genes(my_data)
    centroids_ref <- collapse_genes(centroids_ref)
    centered_data <- median_center(my_data)
    common_genes <- intersect(rownames(centered_data), rownames(centroids_ref))
    message("Found ", length(common_genes), " shared signature genes.")
      
    sub_data <- centered_data[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
    sub_ref  <- centroids_ref[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
    
    cor_matrix <- cor( sub_data, sub_ref, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs" )
    top_idx <- max.col(cor_matrix, ties.method = "first")
    top_cor <- cor_matrix[cbind(seq_len(nrow(cor_matrix)), top_idx)]
    top_subtype <- colnames(cor_matrix)[top_idx]
    
    second_cor <- apply(cor_matrix, 1, function(z) {
        z <- sort(z, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
        if (length(z) < 2) return(NA_real_)
        z[2]
    })
    
    margin <- top_cor - second_cor
    
    pred <- ifelse( is.na(top_cor) | is.na(margin) | margin < min_margin, "Ambiguous", top_subtype)
    
    data.frame( Sample_ID = rownames(cor_matrix), Predicted_Subtype = pred, Max_Correlation = top_cor,
        Second_Correlation = second_cor, Margin = margin, cor_matrix, check.names = FALSE )
}

assign_by_margin <- function(cor_mat, min_margin = 0.05) {
    top_idx <- max.col(cor_mat, ties.method = "first")    
    top_cor <- cor_mat[cbind(seq_len(nrow(cor_mat)), top_idx)]
    top_subtype <- colnames(cor_mat)[top_idx]    
    second_cor <- apply(cor_mat, 1, function(z) {
        z <- sort(z, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
        if (length(z) < 2) return(NA_real_)
        z[2]
    })    
    margin <- top_cor - second_cor
    predicted <- ifelse( is.na(margin) | margin < min_margin, "Ambiguous", top_subtype)
    
    data.frame( Sample_ID = rownames(cor_mat),
        predicted_sclc_classification = predicted, Top_Subtype = top_subtype, Max_Correlation = top_cor,
        Second_Correlation = second_cor, Margin = margin, cor_mat, check.names = FALSE)
}
